Install rumb on Omarchy

Read-only dashboard of pending updates and current problems on Arch and Omarchy

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add rumb
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 0.1.5-1:
    pacman -Qi rumb

Open and use rumb

To see what the package installed, including any commands and desktop entries:

Frequently asked questions

How do I install rumb on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add rumb. The download is 1.3 MB and it takes 2.8 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is rumb free?

Check the project site for current pricing. The package is licensed MIT.

How do I uninstall rumb?

Run omarchy pkg drop rumb. It removes the package from your system.

What does rumb depend on?

The package declares 8 dependencies: bash, curl, fakeroot, gcc-libs, glibc, jq, pacman-contrib, systemd. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is rumb in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as rumb (version 0.1.5-1) in the official Omarchy package repository. HANCORE-linux makes it. Project site: https://github.com/HANCORE-linux/rumb.
